headline: End poverty in all its forms everywhere.
summary: Eradicate extreme poverty, expand social protection, increase access to basic services and assets, and reduce vulnerability to climate and economic shocks.

targets.text_paraphrase: By 2030, eradicate extreme poverty for all people everywhere.
Reduce at least by half the proportion of people living in poverty in all its dimensions.
Implement nationally appropriate social protection systems and floors for all.
Ensure equal rights to economic resources and access to basic services, land, technology and finance.
Build resilience of the poor and reduce exposure to climate-related and economic shocks/disasters.

business_examples.title: Inclusive hiring and living wages
business_examples.description: Create decent jobs for low-income groups with fair wages, benefits, and worker protections.

business_examples.title: Affordable essential services
business_examples.description: Low-cost access to housing, energy, water, healthcare, or finance for vulnerable communities.

business_examples.title: Shock-resilient livelihoods
business_examples.description: Insurance, savings, and climate-resilient assets for disaster-prone regions.

headline: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition, and promote sustainable agriculture.
summary: End hunger and malnutrition while improving sustainable, resilient agriculture, smallholder productivity and food system efficiency.

targets.text_paraphrase: End hunger and ensure access to safe, nutritious and sufficient food year-round.
End all forms of malnutrition including stunting, wasting and micronutrient deficiencies.
Double productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers by 2030.
Ensure sustainable food production systems and resilient agricultural practices.
Maintain genetic diversity of seeds, cultivated plants and farmed animals.

business_examples.title: Solar cold-chain for small farmers
business_examples.description: Reduce post-harvest losses and raise smallholder incomes through renewables-powered storage.

business_examples.title: Climate-smart inputs + advisory
business_examples.description: Bundled irrigation/seed/advisory services to increase yields and resilience.

business_examples.title: Nutrition-fortified food products
business_examples.description: Affordable fortified staples for vulnerable groups.

headline: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.
summary: Universal health coverage, reduced premature mortality, disease prevention, and lower health harms from pollution and unsafe conditions.

targets.text_paraphrase: Reduce premature mortality from non-communicable diseases and promote mental health.
Halve global deaths and injuries from road traffic accidents.
Achieve universal health coverage and access to quality essential services and medicines.
Reduce deaths and illness from pollution and hazardous chemicals.
Strengthen capacity for early warning, risk reduction and health emergency management.

business_examples.title: Affordable digital health platforms
business_examples.description: Telemedicine, diagnostics, and medicine delivery for low-income communities.

business_examples.title: Clean-air / clean-water industry upgrades
business_examples.description: Reduce pollution-related illness via emissions control and safer chemistry.

headline: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.
summary: Universal access to quality schooling, early childhood development, skills for work, and education for sustainable development.

targets.text_paraphrase: Ensure all girls and boys complete free, equitable quality primary and secondary education.
Ensure early childhood development and access to pre-primary education.
Ensure equal access to affordable technical, vocational and tertiary education.
Increase youth and adult skills for employment and entrepreneurship.
Ensure learners acquire knowledge and skills for sustainable development.

business_examples.title: Edtech for underserved learners
business_examples.description: Low-cost digital content/tutoring with offline support for low-resource schools.

business_examples.title: Industry-linked vocational training
business_examples.description: Skill academies aligned to local jobs and green transitions.

headline: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls.
summary: End discrimination and violence, ensure reproductive rights, increase leadership participation, and recognize unpaid care work.

targets.text_paraphrase: End discrimination against women and girls everywhere.
Eliminate violence against women and girls in public and private spheres.
Eliminate harmful practices such as child marriage and FGM.
Recognize and value unpaid care and domestic work.
Ensure women’s full and effective participation and leadership.

business_examples.title: Gender-inclusive workplaces
business_examples.description: Equal pay, safe workplaces, parental support, leadership pipelines.

business_examples.title: Women-focused finance and entrepreneurship
business_examples.description: Credit, insurance and training tailored for women-led MSMEs.

headline: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
summary: Universal safe water and sanitation, improved water quality, efficient withdrawals, and protection of water ecosystems.

targets.text_paraphrase: Universal access to safe and affordable drinking water.
Access to adequate sanitation and hygiene and end open defecation.
Improve water quality and reduce untreated wastewater and pollution.
Increase water-use efficiency and ensure sustainable withdrawals.
Protect and restore water-related ecosystems.

business_examples.title: Water-efficient industrial processes
business_examples.description: Improve recycling/reuse, reduce withdrawal intensity and effluent loads.

business_examples.title: Decentralized WASH solutions
business_examples.description: Low-cost filtration and sanitation systems for peri-urban/rural areas.

headline: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.
summary: Expand renewable energy, universal access, efficient energy use, and clean cooking/technology.

targets.text_paraphrase: Universal access to modern energy services.
Increase substantially the share of renewable energy in the global mix.
Double the global rate of improvement in energy efficiency.
Enhance international cooperation for clean energy research, tech, and investment.
Expand energy infrastructure and upgrade technology for modern services.

business_examples.title: Distributed renewables
business_examples.description: Rooftop solar, mini-grids and PAYG energy access models.

business_examples.title: Industrial energy-efficiency retrofits
business_examples.description: High-efficiency motors, heat recovery, smart metering.

headline: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all.
summary: Sustain inclusive growth, decent jobs, labor rights, productivity, and safe workplaces.

targets.text_paraphrase: Promote development-oriented policies supporting productive activities and MSMEs.
Improve global resource efficiency and decouple growth from environmental degradation.
Achieve full productive employment and equal pay for work of equal value.
Reduce youth not in employment, education or training (NEET).
Protect labor rights and promote safe and secure working environments.

business_examples.title: Formalizing informal work
business_examples.description: Create formal jobs with contracts, protections, and skill pathways.

business_examples.title: Green MSME enablement
business_examples.description: Finance and tech to raise productivity with low environmental footprint.

headline: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation.
summary: Develop sustainable infrastructure, boost clean industry, support SME access to finance/markets, and increase R&D capacity.

targets.text_paraphrase: Develop quality, reliable, sustainable and resilient infrastructure.
Promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and increase industry’s share in employment/GDP.
Increase small-scale industry access to finance and value chains.
Upgrade industries for sustainability and resource efficiency.
Enhance research and innovation capacity.

business_examples.title: Low-carbon manufacturing
business_examples.description: Modernize plants with clean energy and efficient processes.

business_examples.title: Resilient rural infrastructure
business_examples.description: Cold-chains, storage, and logistics to cut losses and emissions.

headline: Reduce inequality within and among countries.
summary: Reduce income inequality, ensure equal opportunity, promote inclusion, and improve global representation.

targets.text_paraphrase: Achieve and sustain income growth of the bottom 40 percent at a higher rate than the national average.
Empower and promote social, economic and political inclusion.
Ensure equal opportunity and reduce discriminatory practices.
Adopt fiscal, wage and social protection policies to progressively achieve greater equality.
Facilitate safe, orderly and regular migration and mobility.

business_examples.title: Inclusive products and pricing
business_examples.description: Affordable services and accessible design for underserved groups.

business_examples.title: Non-discriminatory hiring and advancement
business_examples.description: Bias-free recruitment, accessibility, and pay parity systems.

headline: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.
summary: Affordable housing, safe transport, reduced urban pollution, disaster resilience, and accessible public spaces.

targets.text_paraphrase: Ensure access to adequate, safe and affordable housing and basic services.
Provide safe, affordable, accessible and sustainable transport systems for all.
Enhance inclusive and sustainable urbanization and participatory planning.
Reduce deaths and economic losses from disasters.
Reduce environmental impact of cities, including air quality and waste.

business_examples.title: Clean urban mobility
business_examples.description: EV public transit, shared mobility, low-emission freight hubs.

business_examples.title: Circular construction and housing
business_examples.description: Low-carbon materials and affordable modular housing.

headline: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.
summary: Increase resource efficiency, cut waste/food loss, manage chemicals responsibly, and public/private adoption of sustainable practices.

targets.text_paraphrase: Implement sustainable consumption and production frameworks.
Sustainable management and efficient use of natural resources.
Halve food waste and reduce food losses including post-harvest losses by 2030.
Achieve environmentally sound management of chemicals and wastes.
Substantially reduce waste generation through prevention, reduction, recycling and reuse.

business_examples.title: Solar cold-storage hubs
business_examples.description: Cut post-harvest loss and food waste via efficient storage.

business_examples.title: Circular packaging systems
business_examples.description: Reusable/refill models with high recovery rates.

headline: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.
summary: Mitigation, adaptation, and climate mainstreaming in policies, planning and capacity.

targets.text_paraphrase: Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate hazards and disasters.
Integrate climate measures into national and corporate planning.
Improve education, awareness and capacity on climate mitigation/adaptation.
Mobilize climate finance to implement climate actions.

business_examples.title: Science-based emissions reduction
business_examples.description: Decarbonize operations and value chains with targets and transition plans.

business_examples.title: Climate-resilient supply chains
business_examples.description: Adapt logistics, sourcing, and assets to heat/flood risks.

headline: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and marine resources.
summary: Prevent marine pollution, protect ecosystems, end overfishing, and expand conservation.

targets.text_paraphrase: Prevent and significantly reduce marine pollution of all kinds.
Protect and restore marine and coastal ecosystems.
End overfishing and restore fish stocks sustainably.
Conserve at least 10 percent of coastal and marine areas.

business_examples.title: Ocean-safe packaging
business_examples.description: Replace plastics that leak to oceans with safe, circular alternatives.

business_examples.title: Clean port and shipping solutions
business_examples.description: Reduce ballast waste, fuel emissions, and discharge pollution.

headline: Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems.
summary: Protect forests, halt biodiversity loss, restore degraded land, and prevent invasive species and illegal wildlife trade.

targets.text_paraphrase: Conserve and restore terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems.
Promote sustainable forest management and halt deforestation.
Combat desertification and restore degraded land and soil.
Take action to reduce degradation of habitats and halt biodiversity loss.
End poaching and trafficking of protected species.

business_examples.title: Deforestation-free supply chains
business_examples.description: Verified zero-deforestation sourcing and traceability.

business_examples.title: Nature-positive land restoration
business_examples.description: Reforestation/soil regeneration tied to carbon and water benefits.

headline: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies, justice for all and effective institutions.
summary: Reduce violence and corruption, strengthen rule of law, ensure inclusive decision-making and access to justice.

targets.text_paraphrase: Promote rule of law and ensure equal access to justice for all.
Substantially reduce corruption and bribery.
Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions.
Ensure responsive, inclusive and representative decision-making.
Ensure public access to information and protect fundamental freedoms.

business_examples.title: Strong ethics and anti-corruption
business_examples.description: Compliance systems, whistleblowing, transparent reporting and supplier integrity.

business_examples.title: Community grievance mechanisms
business_examples.description: Open channels for affected communities to report harms and receive remedies.

headline: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development.
summary: Mobilize finance, technology, trade, capacity-building and multi-stakeholder partnerships to achieve the SDGs.

targets.text_paraphrase: Strengthen domestic resource mobilization and improve tax capacity.
Developed countries to implement ODA commitments.
Enhance knowledge-sharing, technology transfer and innovation cooperation.
Enhance global multi-stakeholder partnerships for SDG achievement.
Promote effective public-private and civil society partnerships.

business_examples.title: Impact coalitions
business_examples.description: Co-develop solutions with government/NGOs/industry and shared KPIs.

business_examples.title: Blended-finance SDG funds
business_examples.description: Mobilize private capital into SDG-aligned infrastructure and services.
